screen.caveat: This screen measures tradeability (liquidity, exchange status, history, stability). It does not measure expected return: no signal in this system has demonstrated stock-picking skill (see Evidence → stock-selection studies). A passing stock is one you CAN trade at the modelled cost, not one that will go up.

evidenceStatus: No signal in this system has demonstrated stock-picking skill: 9 pre-registered signals and the quant-v1 model all failed on sealed data (Evidence tab → baselines, stock-selection studies). This report therefore ranks TRADEABILITY, states facts with sources, and makes no directional call.

facts.fact: Sell-side average 1-year target ₹92.57 (range ₹72.72–₹122.85) vs ₹71.75 on 1 Oct 2026. Analyst targets are opinions, not evidence.
FY26 (Q4 2026 call): generation +16% YoY; revenue from operations +12% YoY to ₹11,615 cr; PAT +25% YoY to ₹3,766 cr, helped by Parvati-II and Subansiri Lower commissioning.
Cut iron ore prices in Sep/Oct 2026 (Baila 65.5% lump to ₹5,450/t, −₹250/t MoM; 64% fines to ₹4,700/t, −₹150/t) as steel demand softened; global iron ore ~$91/t, −8% over the month.
Next results due 18 Nov 2026. Market cap ≈ ₹98,367 cr (1 Oct 2026); −17.7% over 3 months, +4% over 12 months.

SMBC holds 24.2% (largest shareholder) after RBI approval to acquire up to 24.99%; has said it will NOT cross 25% (no open offer) and will take no executive role. Stock has traded near the ₹21.5 deal price.
Q2 FY26 (14 Oct 2025): standalone net profit +23.1% YoY to ₹1,633 cr; total income +17.1% to ₹7,974 cr; net NPA 0.18%; PCR 98.3%; gross advances +15.3% YoY. Q2 FY27 results due mid-Oct 2026.
Board meets 24 Oct 2026 for Q2/H1 FY27 results; insider trading window closed 1–26 Oct 2026. Motilal Oswal upgraded to Buy (target ₹105). Fell ~3.5% with other private banks on IRDAI norms.

Order book 5,933 MW at Q1 FY27 (from 5,361 MW a year earlier); ~1.1 GW new orders in FY27 YTD incl. 250 MW from Torrent Green; FY26 record deliveries, EBITDA +63% YoY. Market cap ≈ ₹53,487 cr (1 Oct 2026).

Q2 FY27 results board meeting 15 Oct 2026 (trading window closed to 17 Oct). Provisional Q2: gross advances +18.7% YoY to ₹1,09,519 cr; deposits +18.7% to ₹1,37,258 cr. New MD&CEO Mahesh Muralidhar Pai from 1 Oct 2026 (P R Seshadri retired).

Government cut AGR liability by ~27% (₹23,649 cr) to ₹64,046 cr; 5-year moratorium then 10-year repayment (≥₹124 cr/yr to FY31, ≥₹100 cr/yr to FY35). Citi: Buy-High Risk, target ₹14. Equity remains heavily diluted; government is a large shareholder.

facts.fact: Q2 FY27 provisional: gross disbursements +25.2% YoY to ₹19,930 cr; AUM +24.8% YoY to ₹1.58 lakh cr. Board meeting 16 Oct 2026 for results. Stock −14% YTD; sector note (1 Oct 2026) flags rising cost of funds for NBFC/HFCs.

RBI returned the universal-bank licence application (Apr 2026) asking for a more diversified loan book; shares fell ~6%. Deposits +22.4%, CASA +33.2%, 777 branches; concerns over portfolio mix and margins remain.

Government OFS enlarged to 1.86% of equity (24.31 cr shares) after greenshoe — supply overhang. ₹13,527 cr term loan to L&T Metro Rail (Hyderabad) refinancing; ₹4,200 cr loan to DVC (28 Sep 2026). GST show-cause notice ₹396.9 cr (29 Sep 2026).

FY26 consolidated total income ₹416.9 cr (+34.9% YoY); net profit ₹25.3 cr (+89.1%). Q1 FY27 revenue ₹124.9 cr, profit ₹9.6 cr. Market cap ≈ ₹2,954 cr (6 Oct 2026). Garment exporter + travel business, Mirzapur UP. Not in any NSE broad index; +187% over 1 year — momentum of this size in a micro-cap is itself a risk flag.

facts.fact: Q2 FY27 provisional: gross advances +29.8% YoY; total business +20.6%; deposits +14.4%; CASA +9.2%. Three senior management portfolio changes from 1 Oct 2026. Trading window closed until 48h after Q2 results.

1:2 bonus issue went ex recently (bonus shares credited by 31 Oct 2026) — unadjusted price history shows a ~33% drop that is NOT a loss. Order wins: ₹28.78 cr (1 Oct 2026), ₹144.98 cr across 7 projects (15 Sep 2026). Navratna PSU under MoHUA.

Group operating capacity 11,262.51 MW after 50 MW (RTC project, 2 Oct 2026) and 153.94 MW Kalasar solar units (1 Oct 2026) went commercial. Q1 FY27 revenue ₹1,121.7 cr, profit ₹304.8 cr. Market cap ≈ ₹76,755 cr (1 Oct 2026). Trading window closed until Q2 results.

Trading window closed from 1 Oct 2026 until Q2 FY27 results. Market cap ≈ ₹47,317 cr (1 Oct 2026). MD&CEO Gunender Kapur re-appointed for 5 years from 1 Sep 2026. One rating service (MarketsMojo) rates it Sell (31 Aug 2026) — an opinion, not evidence.
Fresh 52-week low ₹33.73 on 1 Oct 2026 with no identified company-specific trigger; −28% over 12 months, −20% over 3 months. Market cap ≈ ₹22,236 cr. Dividend ₹0.58/share (Apr 2026), yield ≈ 1.7%.

Pure-play US healthcare services (BPO) provider. Global General Counsel changed 2 Oct 2026 (Daniel Bailey out, Brian Clayton in). FY26 final dividend ₹0.10 (record 7 Aug 2026). Trading window closed from 1 Oct 2026 pending Q2 results. Revenue is USD-linked: INR and US healthcare policy are the macro exposures.

Adani Power is buying the 24% promoter stake (from Jaiprakash Associates, under JAL's CIRP resolution plan approved by NCLT 17 Mar 2026) for ₹2,994 cr; SPA signed 20 May 2026. JPVL stays listed; public holds the majority. 2,220 MW thermal+hydro, plus coal/sand mining and cement grinding. Stock hit upper circuit on the announcement.

facts.fact: Debt Raising Committee meets 9 Oct 2026 on call-option redemption of ₹150 cr NCDs. P/E ≈ 38 (1 Oct 2026); market cap ≈ ₹13,739 cr; 52-week range ₹67.50–91.40. One rating service rates it Sell (24 Sep 2026) — an opinion.

India Ratings upgraded IOB and its Tier II bonds to IND AA+/Stable on 5 Oct 2026. Market cap ≈ ₹60,369 cr. Trading window closed from 1 Oct 2026 pending Q2 results. Government holds a very large stake (low float).

52-week low ₹21.06 on 1 Oct 2026 after a 4-day, −9.7% slide; −11.9% over the month. Market cap ≈ ₹4,542 cr. Permitted to sell 50,000 t of refined sugar domestically in the Oct fortnight quota. Trading window closed from 1 Oct 2026 pending Sept-quarter results. Sugar/ethanol policy is the key driver.

Sept–Oct 2026 fall tied to NSE IPO pricing (reports of ₹1,700–1,785 vs ₹2,000–2,100 earlier) — IFCI holds NSE indirectly via Stock Holding Corp of India, so the stock trades as a proxy for NSE's valuation. Very volatile (55% ann.) and low delivery (24%): speculative positioning dominates. AGM held 25 Sep 2026.

facts.fact: Q1 FY27 total income ₹1,803 cr (+9.3% QoQ, +4.4% YoY). Dividend ₹0.50/share (May 2026), yield ≈ 2.2%. −22.9% over 1 year. Ludhiana-based: yarn, bath/bed linen, paper, chemicals. US tariff/export demand is the key external exposure.

Q2 FY27 provisional: total business ₹6.37 lakh cr (+18.8% YoY); advances +24.7%; deposits +14.1%. 52-week range ₹22.22–34.2 (near the low). UFBU union strike notice covering 11 Sep–30 Oct 2026 — possible operational disruption. Trading window closed pending Q2 results.
Q2 FY27 provisional: deposits +10.9% YoY, advances +8.6% — slow growth. Net slippages rose to 4.35% from 3.16% (asset quality worsening). −6.5% over the month, +19% over 12 months.

Q2 FY26 consolidated revenue +64.6% YoY to ₹158.3 cr, net profit +58.7% to ₹16.3 cr; FY26 revenue +22.2%. BSE dual listing from 15 Apr 2026. Aug 2026: board to consider equity fundraising (dilution risk); launched ResolX AI platform. Not in any NSE broad index; +79% over a year, at its 1y high.

facts.fact: Strategic sale of 60.72% (GoI 30.48% + LIC 30.24%) in final stages; revised bids from Fairfax (reported ₹81/share, ≈₹53,000 cr for the stake) and Emirates NBD under review; RBI fit-and-proper cleared. An open offer to public shareholders at the deal price remains possible — the stock trades (~₹86) ABOVE the reported bid. Q2 FY27 business ₹6.27 lakh cr (+18%).

Standalone net profit ₹193.9 cr in Q1 FY27 (+108% YoY) after ₹190.9 cr in Q4 FY26 (+88%). ₹200 cr preferential warrants to Vibrant Enterprises approved at EGM 21 May 2026 (promoter-side dilution/funding). AGM 12 Sep 2026. 52-week range ₹64.4–117. Vol 44% ann. — steel/iron: cyclical.

Statutory auditor rotated after 63rd AGM (17 Sep 2026): CAG appointed R S P H & Associates for FY27. Trading window closed from 1 Oct 2026 pending results. Government trading PSU with a thin core business; price is sentiment-driven.

Operating under a SEBI market ban on the promoter side; won interim relief to proceed with a ~$330M capital raise approved by shareholders. NCLAT hearing on lenders' plea re the Chandra IBC plan deferred to Oct 2026. FY26 dividend ₹2/share payable 17 Oct 2026. Vol 53% ann., delivery 30%: event-driven trading, not investing.
